raw_message.reasoning:
We need to add new functions: cmd_bump, cmd_check, cmd_compare. Also need to add static method isvalid to VersionInfo. Also modify regex to align with official semver.org spec? The existing regex seems somewhat aligned but maybe missing some aspects: It allows prerelease: (?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*) but spec says identifiers must not be empty, numeric identifiers must not have leading zeroes. The regex allows leading zeros for numeric only? It allows 0 or [1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*, so numeric identifiers like 01 are invalid? Actually [1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]* allows leading digits 1-9 but also allows letters/hyphen. So numeric part 01 would start with 0 then digit? That fails because first char is 0 and not allowed because alternative 0 matches only single 0. So 01 fails. Good.

But spec says build metadata identifiers may contain digits and letters but not hyphens? Actually build can have hyphens. It's fine.

Need to add cmd_check subcommand to CLI. Let's inspect CLI usage. Search for createparser.
